code:
@task
def train_with_reproducibility(data_uri, config):
    np.random.seed(config["seed"])
    torch.manual_seed(config["seed"])
    sha = get_git_sha()

    with mlflow.start_run():
        mlflow.log_params(config)
        mlflow.log_param("git_sha", sha)
        model = fit_model(data_uri, config)
        metrics = evaluate(model)
        if metrics["auc"] >= config["min_auc"]:
            mlflow.register_model(model, "fraud")
caption: All five commitments, captured in one place, every time the task runs.

code:
@dsl.component(
    base_image="python:3.11-slim@sha256:9c7f...",
    packages_to_install=["torch==2.4.0"],
)
def train(data_uri: str, config: dict,
           model: Output[Model]):
    np.random.seed(config["seed"])
    torch.manual_seed(config["seed"])
    with mlflow.start_run():
        mlflow.log_params(config)
        clf = fit_model(data_uri, config)
        save_model(clf, model.path)
caption: The base_image digest pins the environment; the body still seeds, logs, and trains.
